definition: an image or character representing a person online
hook: Your avatar is a god coming down to earth.
modernAnchor: A little circle beside your name, a character you steer through a game. We call it an avatar.
journey: Sanskrit avatara is built from ava, down, and tri, to cross over. Together they mean a crossing down, a descent.
In Hindu tradition it named something exact: a deity crossing out of the divine world and taking a body in this one. Vishnu is counted as having ten.
English borrowed the word in the 1700s with that meaning intact, and used it that way for roughly two centuries.
Then computers needed a name for the body you take on inside a world that is not your own, and reached for it. The descent was always the whole idea.
